items_flat.title_en: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5, first model in the Claude 5.5 family
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，Claude 5.5 系列首發
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5 as available today, calling it the first model in a new Claude 5.5 family. Official copy says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most work and costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads. API list prices are $4 / $20 per million input / output tokens, with cache reads at $0.20; the model is live on the Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry as claude-opus-5-5. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are slated for the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Opus 5.5 即日起可用，為新 Claude 5.5 家族首款模型。官方稱多數工作表現達 Claude Fable 5.1 水準，典型負載成本較 Opus 5 約低 40%。API 定價為每百萬 token 輸入 $4、輸出 $20，快取讀取 $0.20；已上線 Claude Platform、AWS、Google Cloud 與 Microsoft Foundry，模型 ID 為 claude-opus-5-5。Sonnet 5.5 與 Haiku 5.5 將於未來數週推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a mid-cycle price/performance squeeze on Anthropic’s daily-driver Opus tier, not a claimed new intelligence peak: the pitch is Fable-class utility at a cheaper Opus bill, with cache-read cuts aimed at long agent runs. What remains uncertain is how much of the reported benchmark lead over GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 survives independent harnesses once production safeguards intervene on cyber and biology tasks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對 Anthropic 日常主力 Opus 層級的中期性價比壓縮，而非宣稱新的智力巔峰：賣點是以更便宜的 Opus 帳單接近 Fable 級實用性，快取讀取降價針對長時 agent。不確定點在於：官方相對 GPT-6 Astra、Fable 5.1 的基準領先，在獨立評測與生產防護介入資安／生物任務後能保留多少。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 Claude Opus 5.5，這是新 Claude 5.5 家族的第一款模型。多數工作表現達 Claude Fable 5.1 水準，運行成本較 Opus 5 低 40%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands GPT-6 with Sol and Luna, cuts API prices 50%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴充 GPT-6：推出 Sol 與 Luna，API 價格腰斬
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as faster, cheaper siblings that it says were trained with similar methods to GPT-6 Astra. API prices fall 50% versus GPT-5.6 promotional rates: Sol to $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens, Luna to $0.10 / $0.50. Both rolled out in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu; both are in the API, and Free/Go users can try Luna in the desktop app.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-6 Luna，稱以與 GPT-6 Astra 相近的方法訓練、更便宜更快。相對 GPT-5.6 促銷價，API 降 50%：Sol 為每百萬 token 輸入 $2／輸出 $10，Luna 為 $0.10／$0.50。已在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 對 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise、Edu 上線，並開放 API；Free／Go 可在桌面版試用 Luna。
items_flat.analysis_en: OpenAI is productizing Astra’s generation as a cost ladder rather than waiting for another flagship: Sol is positioned as the scaled workhorse, Luna as high-volume cheap inference. Company-run benchmarks show Sol beating older Opus 5 on some workflow tests at a fraction of the cost; head-to-head with same-day Opus 5.5 is not independently settled.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 把 Astra 這一代做成成本階梯，而不是再等下一款旗艦：Sol 定位為可規模化主力，Luna 則是高量廉價推論。官方基準顯示 Sol 在部分工作流上以更低成本勝過舊款 Opus 5；與同日發布的 Opus 5.5 對打尚未有獨立定論。
items_flat.quote: We’ve also made caching and inference more efficient, and we’re passing the savings directly to you: 50% lower API prices for Sol and Luna compared with GPT‑5.6 promotional pricing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們也讓快取與推論更有效率，並把節省直接回饋給你：Sol 與 Luna 的 API 價格較 GPT-5.6 促銷價低 50%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes priorities for independent third-party safety assessments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布獨立第三方安全評估的優先項目與原則
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a safety post committing to support independent assessments with access across training, evaluation, and deployment, framed as part of its effort to “pace the frontier.” The note lists four priority areas, starting with independent review of safety cases, plus principles for rigor, independence, security, and publication. No named assessor, start date, or access contract was announced.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布安全聲明，承諾支援涵蓋訓練、評估與部署的獨立第三方評估，並將其納入「放慢前沿步調」的努力。文中列出四項優先領域（首項為獨立檢視 safety case），以及嚴謹、獨立、安全與公開的原則。尚未公布具體評估方、時程或存取契約。
items_flat.analysis_en: This converts a recent executive pledge into a process document, not a completed audit: it defines what OpenAI wants assessors to look at and how findings might be handled, while leaving partners and timelines unspecified. Its practical force depends on whether named groups later get training-time access and publication rights, not on the blog post alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把近期高層承諾落成流程文件，而非已完成的審計：它定義 OpenAI 希望評估方看什麼、發現如何處理，但夥伴與時程仍未指定。實際效力取決於具名機構之後是否取得訓練期存取與公開權，而非這篇網誌本身。
items_flat.quote: As part of our efforts to pace the frontier, we’re committed to supporting independent assessments with deep levels of access across training, evaluation, and deployment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為放慢前沿步調努力的一部分，我們承諾支援在訓練、評估與部署各階段提供深度存取的獨立評估。
